title: Policies and regulations — Broadford Cemetery Trust (draft)
metaDescription: The Broadford Cemetery Trust's Decorations Policy and General Regulations — what may be placed on a grave and the rules that apply in the cemetery.

header.heading: Policies and regulations
header.lead: Two documents govern what may be placed on a grave and how the cemetery is used. Both are available from the Trust on request.

copyNotice.label: Ask for a copy
copyNotice.body: The Decorations Policy and the General Regulations are both available from the Trust on request.

figure.alt: A green wrought-iron pedestrian gate carrying a cream Broadford Cemetery Trust sign with the Trust’s postal address and email, and a smaller sign about additions and alterations, looking down a grassed avenue towards the niche wall.
figure.caption: The pedestrian gate on Piper Street, with the Trust’s enquiries sign.
